task.description:
Close ISS-0467 per WF-03 Step 5 (docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md). This run's fix is a real root-cause closure: the gap (a bare git push to main silently bypassing 0018's required-status-checks protection) is closed by removing the alternate path entirely -- GIT_MERGE.md now explicitly prohibits any direct push to main, and ORCHESTRATOR.md sec.10 no longer leaves ambiguous whether the sizing-rule exception licenses skipping the branch+PR procedure. This qualifies as `status: resolved` (per ISSUE_QUEUE.md's vocabulary: 'a root cause was actually removed') -- NOT `instrumented` or `no_defect`. Note this is a documentation/procedural fix, not a code fix, so there is no regression test file to cite the way a code fix would; cite the actual textual changes and their commits instead as the resolving evidence.

1. Update docs/issues/ISS-0467.yaml: status: resolved, resolved_in_run: WF03-ISS0467-20260904, resolved_at: <real UTC timestamp>, and a resolution: block summarizing what was decided (Option 2, prohibition) and why (Option 1 is a no-op given the single-identity auth setup, per ISSUE-FIXER's own live diagnosis in step-01-issue-fixer.json), plus pointers to the three files changed and the design artefact.
2. Close GitHub issue #896: `gh issue close 896 --comment "..."`. Per WF-03 Step 5's evidence rule, the comment must cite the resolving run-id and the docs/issues/ISS-0467.yaml record, and since this is `resolved` (not instrumented/no_defect), it may also cite the fix commit(s) -- there is no regression test path to cite (docs-only fix), say so plainly rather than inventing one.
3. Complete this handoff PASS, next_action: "Route to Step Final (git merge)".
